dna.source: J-01: analysis of reading hierarchy and explicit product adaptation
dna.pass: One essay title leads the first glance; secondary choices visibly recede.
dna.failure: Equal-weight preview cards compete with the main essay title.
dna.strategy_rule: Prioritize title comprehension, then reading continuity, then discovery.

dna.source: J-05: analysis of reading hierarchy and explicit product adaptation
dna.pass: Whitespace separates prose groups without repeated card containment.
dna.failure: Every paragraph or article row gains its own border and shadow.
dna.strategy_rule: Prioritize title comprehension, then reading continuity, then discovery.

dna.source: J-02: analysis of reading hierarchy and explicit product adaptation
dna.pass: The read action has stronger concentrated emphasis than saving or navigation.
dna.failure: Save and all navigation items receive the same filled brand treatment.
dna.strategy_rule: Prioritize title comprehension, then reading continuity, then discovery.

dna.source: J-03: analysis of reading hierarchy and explicit product adaptation
dna.pass: Serif title and neutral body roles remain clearly distinguishable.
dna.failure: All title and body roles differ only by a negligible size change.
dna.strategy_rule: Prioritize title comprehension, then reading continuity, then discovery.

dna.source: J-09: analysis of reading hierarchy and explicit product adaptation
dna.pass: State feedback preserves the reading column and current text position.
dna.failure: Feedback overlays or shifts the paragraph currently being read.
dna.strategy_rule: Prioritize title comprehension, then reading continuity, then discovery.

dna.source: J-07: analysis of reading hierarchy and explicit product adaptation
dna.pass: Outline icons assist adjacent words with consistent weight and no competing focus.
dna.failure: Mixed icon weights or circular badges become the visual focus.
dna.strategy_rule: Prioritize title comprehension, then reading continuity, then discovery.

exceptions.item: Decorative photographic content for essay selection
exceptions.scope: Current text-only essay selection and reading screens
exceptions.reason: Title and synopsis already carry subject and mood; media would compete.
exceptions.alternative: Retain complete textual hierarchy and intentional neutral canvas.

exceptions.item: Expansion and expressive decorative motion behaviors
exceptions.scope: No expandable region exists in the current reading inventory
exceptions.reason: Animation without a state purpose adds attention cost for readers.
exceptions.alternative: Immediate reduced-motion feedback and short continuity transitions.
